\section{Findings on the documentation}\label{sec:docs-findings}

Twenty findings: 3 major, 13 minor, 4 notes; none critical. None is a divergence from leanVM in the sense of the brief (the documents disagree with each other and with the repository, not with the pinned sources), except where a finding says otherwise; the classification line says so each time. Proposed changes that are long are in \cref{sec:docs-texts} and referenced.

\begin{finding}{major}{f:docs-base-theorem-hypothesis}{The base theorem of extraction lacks the program hypothesis its own composition needs}
\fhead{Severity} major (a statement cannot be proved as written).
\fhead{Evidence} blueprint Layer 13, \texttt{protocol-\allowbreak{}blueprint.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}1247-\allowbreak{}1250}: ``\texttt{theorem base\allowbreak{}Verifier\_\allowbreak{}extracts\allowbreak{}Execution (\allowbreak{}fs bcs mca flock) (\allowbreak{}h :\allowbreak{} verify prog input proof = true) :\allowbreak{} except with probability ni\allowbreak{}Error,\allowbreak{} ∃ t,\allowbreak{} Valid\allowbreak{}Execution prog input t}'' and ``\texttt{theorem base\allowbreak{}Prover\_\allowbreak{}complete (\allowbreak{}hfill :\allowbreak{} Has\allowbreak{}Fill\allowbreak{}Blocks prog) (\allowbreak{}h :\allowbreak{} Valid\allowbreak{}Execution prog input t) :\allowbreak{} …}'', said to compose \texttt{constraint\allowbreak{}Soundness} and \texttt{constraint\allowbreak{}Completeness} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}1253-\allowbreak{}1255}); the contract row \texttt{:\allowbreak{}222} consumes ``\texttt{constraint\allowbreak{}Soundness}, \texttt{HasFillBlocks}, \texttt{constraint\allowbreak{}Completeness} (Layer 10)''. The leanISA blueprint states both with a program hypothesis (\texttt{leanisa-\allowbreak{}blueprint.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}1156-\allowbreak{}1166}): ``\texttt{theorem constraint\allowbreak{}Soundness (\allowbreak{}hwf :\allowbreak{} Well\allowbreak{}Formed\allowbreak{}Bytecode prog) (\allowbreak{}h :\allowbreak{} Satisfied\allowbreak{}By prog input w) :\allowbreak{} …}'', ``\texttt{theorem constraint\allowbreak{}Completeness (\allowbreak{}hwf :\allowbreak{} Well\allowbreak{}Formed\allowbreak{}Bytecode prog) …}'', where \texttt{Well\allowbreak{}Formed\allowbreak{}Bytecode} has two fields, \texttt{sentinelSafe} and \texttt{hasFillBlocks}. \texttt{architecture.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}224-\allowbreak{}228}: ``Both directions are stated for well-formed programs … a hypothesis of each, since the constraint system enforces neither''. \texttt{leanvm-\allowbreak{}target.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}57-\allowbreak{}62} gives the reason: a bytecode whose sentinel slot holds a \texttt{JUMP} ``admits accepted walks that execute the sentinel''. The hole comment repeats both statements (\texttt{issue-\allowbreak{}12-\allowbreak{}comment-\allowbreak{}5833669972.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}190}). So the soundness theorem cannot be obtained by the composition it names, and the completeness theorem's \texttt{HasFillBlocks} does not give \texttt{constraint\allowbreak{}Completeness}'s hypothesis.
\fhead{Classification} an error of the blueprint, against the leanISA roadmap (the program condition itself is faithful to leanVM, where the compiler guarantees it: \texttt{leanvm-\allowbreak{}target.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}60-\allowbreak{}62}).
\fhead{Proposed change} \texttt{:\allowbreak{}1247-\allowbreak{}1250} become

\begin{srccode}
`theorem baseVerifier_extractsExecution (fs bcs mca flock) (hwf : WellFormedBytecode prog) (h : verify prog input proof = true) : except with probability niError, ∃ t, ValidExecution prog input t`
\end{srccode}

and

\begin{srccode}
`theorem baseProver_complete (hwf : WellFormedBytecode prog) (h : ValidExecution prog input t) : verify prog input (prove prog input (witness of t)) = true`
\end{srccode}

\texttt{:\allowbreak{}222} consumes

\begin{srccode}
`constraintSoundness`, `WellFormedBytecode`, `constraintCompleteness` (leanISA Layer 10)
\end{srccode}

Reason: the named composition then typechecks, and the hypothesis is visible in the statement a reader audits.

\textbf{[TECHNICAL CHANGES TO BE INSERTED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR: the alternative, \texttt{verify} deciding the program condition on the public program and rejecting otherwise, removes the hypothesis from the soundness theorem; which one the blueprint takes is a technical decision.]}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{major}{f:docs-hole-comment}{The blueprint hands the specification of the holes to a tracker comment that contradicts it}
\fhead{Severity} major (through the delegation, the blueprint specifies a public-input transcript leanVM does not use, and signatures that cannot be stated).
\fhead{Evidence} the blueprint sends the reader to the comment three times (\texttt{protocol-\allowbreak{}blueprint.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}339-\allowbreak{}340} ``its specification is a section of the hole comment''; \texttt{:\allowbreak{}590-\allowbreak{}591} ``Its specification is a section of the hole comment on the dashboard \#12''; \texttt{:\allowbreak{}1485-\allowbreak{}1487}). The tracker body says it ``holds nothing that is not in them'' (\texttt{issue-\allowbreak{}12-\allowbreak{}body.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}6}). The comment's own head says only four of its thirteen sections were rewritten after the spine was built (\texttt{issue-\allowbreak{}12-\allowbreak{}comment-\allowbreak{}5833669972.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}3}); the other sections still give the pre-spine signatures (\cref{sec:docs-hole-comment}, items 1 to 3, 5, 7, 8), which do not typecheck against \texttt{Phase.\allowbreak{}Def} as built (\texttt{Leaner\allowbreak{}VM/\allowbreak{}Protocol/\allowbreak{}Spine/\allowbreak{}Phase.\allowbreak{}lean:\allowbreak{}37}, three arguments). Its section on the public-input phase says ``the prover sends nothing'' (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}93-\allowbreak{}94}), while leanVM's §8.2 says ``The verifier samples $r_m\in\E$, the prover sends $c_0,c_1$ claiming …'' (\texttt{doc/\allowbreak{}leanvm/\allowbreak{}body/\allowbreak{}08-\allowbreak{}end-\allowbreak{}to-\allowbreak{}end-\allowbreak{}protocol.\allowbreak{}tex:\allowbreak{}29} at \texttt{a386121f}), and the Rust verifier reads the two scalars (``\texttt{*v = vs.\allowbreak{}next\_\allowbreak{}scalar(\allowbreak{})…}'', \texttt{crates/\allowbreak{}lean\_\allowbreak{}vm/\allowbreak{}src/\allowbreak{}cpu/\allowbreak{}mod.\allowbreak{}rs:\allowbreak{}746-\allowbreak{}749}), and the phase on \texttt{main} follows it (\texttt{Public\allowbreak{}Input.\allowbreak{}p\allowbreak{}Spec}, \texttt{Leaner\allowbreak{}VM/\allowbreak{}Protocol/\allowbreak{}Public\allowbreak{}Input.\allowbreak{}lean:\allowbreak{}99}: ``\texttt{def p\allowbreak{}Spec :\allowbreak{} Protocol\allowbreak{}Spec 2 :\allowbreak{}= ⟨!v[.\allowbreak{}V\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}P,\allowbreak{} .\allowbreak{}P\_\allowbreak{}to\_\allowbreak{}V],\allowbreak{} !v[E,\allowbreak{} List E]⟩}''). The comment also holds tests and one technical remark found nowhere else (\cref{sec:docs-text-tracker}, column ``only in the comment'').
\fhead{Classification} an error of the blueprint (its delegated specification of the public-input phase differs from leanVM's §8.2; the built phase is faithful).
\fhead{Proposed change} move each section as \cref{sec:docs-text-tracker} says; replace the three pointers as \cref{sec:docs-text-holes} and \cref{sec:docs-text-tracking} say; edit the comment in place to the pointer of \cref{sec:docs-text-tracker}.
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{major}{f:docs-sketch-types}{The per-layer sketches use types the spine does not have}
\fhead{Severity} major (the statements cannot be stated as written).
\fhead{Evidence} \cref{sec:docs-sketches}, items 1 to 9: Layer 6's local \texttt{structure Bus\allowbreak{}Out where ζ … rem … pool :\allowbreak{} List Claim … α … β} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}960-\allowbreak{}964}) against the spine's \texttt{BusOut I} of two claim lists (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}481}; \texttt{Seams.\allowbreak{}lean:\allowbreak{}130-\allowbreak{}135}); Layer 7's \texttt{table\allowbreak{}Sumcheck … (\allowbreak{}Stmt\allowbreak{}In :\allowbreak{}= Bus\allowbreak{}Out) … (\allowbreak{}Stmt\allowbreak{}Out :\allowbreak{}= Bus\allowbreak{}Out × Column\allowbreak{}Claims)} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}988}) against \texttt{Phases.\allowbreak{}table} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}533}); Layer 9's \texttt{FlockInterface} with an \texttt{Oracle\allowbreak{}Reduction} field from \texttt{ColumnClaims} to \texttt{WeightedClaim} and an unbound \texttt{s} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}1077-\allowbreak{}1085}) against \texttt{Phases.\allowbreak{}flock} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}535}); Layer 10's own \texttt{Weight}, \texttt{WeightedClaim}, \texttt{Claim.\allowbreak{}to\allowbreak{}Weighted}, \texttt{lean\allowbreak{}Vm\allowbreak{}Piop (\allowbreak{}prog) (\allowbreak{}s) (\allowbreak{}input) (\allowbreak{}flock)} over \texttt{M3Witness} and \texttt{m3Relation}, and master theorems with \texttt{Set.\allowbreak{}univ} and \texttt{rbr\allowbreak{}Knowledge\allowbreak{}Soundness} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}1109-\allowbreak{}1130}) against the spine's (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}541-\allowbreak{}547}; \texttt{Compose.\allowbreak{}lean:\allowbreak{}162-\allowbreak{}177}); \texttt{Sumcheck.\allowbreak{}Def}, \texttt{Gkr.\allowbreak{}Def}, \texttt{Batch.\allowbreak{}Def} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}952,\allowbreak{} 984,\allowbreak{} 1104}), which exist nowhere; seven names used and never defined (\texttt{Claim}, \texttt{ColumnClaims}, \texttt{LeafLayout}, \texttt{StackLayout}, \texttt{M3Witness}, \texttt{m3Relation}, \texttt{commitPhase}). Layer 8 (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}1011-\allowbreak{}1027}) is the only phase sketch on the spine's types.
\fhead{Classification} an error of the blueprint.
\fhead{Proposed change} restate Layers 6, 7, 9 and 10 on Layer 8's pattern:

\begin{srccode}
`def busPhase (I : M3Instance) : Phase.Def I I.Stmt (I.Stmt × BusOut I)`
`def busComplete I : Phase.Complete I (busPhase I) (Seam.commit I) (Seam.bus I)`
`def busSecurity I : Phase.Security I (busPhase I) (Seam.commit I) (Seam.bus I)`
\end{srccode}

and likewise \texttt{tableSumcheck} (from \texttt{Seam.\allowbreak{}bus} to \texttt{Seam.\allowbreak{}table}), the Flock phase (\texttt{Seam.\allowbreak{}pub} to \texttt{Seam.\allowbreak{}flock}) and \texttt{openingPhase} (\texttt{Seam.\allowbreak{}flock} to \texttt{Seam.\allowbreak{}done}); delete Layer 6's \texttt{BusOut}, Layer 10's \texttt{Weight}, \texttt{WeightedClaim} and its \texttt{leanVmPiop} block (the spine's are in ``What the spine fixes''); restate the generic components of Layers 4 and 5 as \texttt{Component.\allowbreak{}Def}s with their \texttt{Complete} and \texttt{Security}, and their theorems in the \texttt{rbr\allowbreak{}Knowledge\allowbreak{}Soundness\allowbreak{}Worst\allowbreak{}Case\allowbreak{}With} form of convention \emph{Holes} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}332}). Reason: the spine is built and is the contract.

\textbf{[TECHNICAL CHANGES TO BE INSERTED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR: the message schedules, errors and internal relations of each phase, and the opening phase's schedule against specification §8.5.]}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{minor}{f:docs-status-stale}{The status and the tracker describe a repository two merges old}
\fhead{Severity} minor (stale text), the most visible one.
\fhead{Evidence} \cref{sec:docs-status-stale} (the status heads itself as a snapshot of \texttt{f4d858c} and calls the public-input phase a draft on a branch; fifteen items), \cref{sec:docs-tracker-stale} (the tracker shows Layer 1 in review behind the closed \#18, the public-input phase open with the opposite transcript, four closed pull requests as open, ``revision 2'' defined nowhere, and renders ``ArkLib \#1'', ``ArkLib \#4'' and ``\#3 there'' as links to leanerVM items), \cref{sec:docs-pins} (both say the pins are unchanged; pull request 61 moved four). The Layer 1 review's two edits of the tracker were never made (\texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}reviews/\allowbreak{}protocol-\allowbreak{}layer1.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}211}). \texttt{README.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}32-\allowbreak{}33} says ``no proof-system claim has landed'' and \texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}README.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}38-\allowbreak{}47} says the three reviewed branches are still branches.
\fhead{Classification} not a divergence from leanVM.
\fhead{Proposed change} \cref{sec:docs-text-status} (status), \cref{sec:docs-text-tracker} (tracker body). \texttt{README.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}32-\allowbreak{}33}:

\begin{srccode}
The proof system's spine, with its two master theorems conditional on the phases, Layer 1 and the public-input phase are on `main`; see `docs/roadmap/protocol-status.md`.
\end{srccode}

\texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}README.\allowbreak{}md}: ``whose findings the branch now meets'' becomes ``whose findings were met before it merged'', in the three entries. For the future: a status whose coverage is checked against the repository (\cref{sec:docs-status-contents}) cannot drift this way unnoticed.
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{minor}{f:docs-letter-codes}{Letter codes collide, and some point at the wrong thing}
\fhead{Severity} minor (avoidable reading cost; two misdirected references).
\fhead{Evidence} \cref{sec:docs-codes}: at least 128 codes and 1036 occurrences in the eight texts; 34 codes with two or more meanings inside the proof system's own documents (the code \texttt{C1} has five: a hole, a ledger entry, and a finding of each of the three reviews), 11 more that mean something else in the leanISA status; within the status alone \texttt{A1} and \texttt{C1} each have four meanings. Two references resolve to the wrong finding: ``finding F3 of the status file'' (\texttt{protocol-\allowbreak{}blueprint.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}1440}) means the leanISA status's finding, the protocol status's being ``one root for push and pull'' (\cref{sec:docs-repository}, item 9); and the status's legend says its letter \texttt{F} continues the leanISA numbering (\texttt{protocol-\allowbreak{}status.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}281-\allowbreak{}283}), where leanISA's letter for the same subject is \texttt{R} (\cref{sec:docs-status-stale}, item 13). The blueprint's ``the generic holes carry the ledger letters of the ArkLib work they will become'' (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}592-\allowbreak{}593}) is false (\cref{sec:docs-sketches}, item 12). The codes have reached the trackers: issue 28 ``Layer 2/C1'', issue 23 ``P3'', issue 31 ``P05'' (\cref{sec:docs-code-collisions}).
\fhead{Classification} not a divergence from leanVM.
\fhead{Proposed change} \cref{sec:docs-proposal-codes} (names for holes, ledger entries and findings; numbers kept, with names, for layers, acceptance tests, decisions and target theorems; one index, drafted in \cref{sec:docs-codes-index-draft}). The two misdirected references: \texttt{:\allowbreak{}1440} ``(finding F3 of the status file)'' becomes

\begin{srccode}
(the leanISA status's finding on the BLAKE2S value limbs)
\end{srccode}

\texttt{protocol-\allowbreak{}status.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}282-\allowbreak{}283} ``\textbf{F} = Rust versus specification, continuing the leanISA numbering where the subject overlaps'' becomes

\begin{srccode}
**F** = Rust or Python versus the specification (numbered independently of the leanISA status, whose letter for this is **R**)
\end{srccode}

until \cref{sec:docs-proposal-codes} retires the letters.
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{minor}{f:docs-import-rule}{The import rule of the proof system is false of \texttt{main} as written}
\fhead{Severity} minor.
\fhead{Evidence} \cref{sec:docs-repository}, item 12: convention \emph{The wall} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}331}) lists the modules allowed to import \texttt{Leaner\allowbreak{}VM/\allowbreak{}Arithmetization/\allowbreak{}}, and acceptance test 25 (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}1341-\allowbreak{}1345}) takes as its witness a \texttt{grep} that ``lists the exceptions of convention \emph{The wall} only''. The \texttt{grep} returns \texttt{Leaner\allowbreak{}VM/\allowbreak{}Protocol/\allowbreak{}Fixed\allowbreak{}Columns.\allowbreak{}lean:\allowbreak{}11} and \texttt{Leaner\allowbreak{}VM/\allowbreak{}Protocol/\allowbreak{}Basic.\allowbreak{}lean:\allowbreak{}3} (\texttt{public import Leaner\allowbreak{}VM.\allowbreak{}Arithmetization.\allowbreak{}Basic}); \texttt{Basic.\allowbreak{}lean} is the layer's empty root module (a docstring and an empty section), imported by \texttt{Leaner\allowbreak{}VM.\allowbreak{}lean:\allowbreak{}19} and by no module. It exposes nothing, so no phase sees the arithmetization through it; the rule's statement and its test are what is wrong. The rule has no script (\texttt{scripts/\allowbreak{}check-\allowbreak{}layers.\allowbreak{}sh:\allowbreak{}30-\allowbreak{}41} checks the layer DAG only), as the Layer 1 review found.
\fhead{Classification} not a divergence from leanVM.
\fhead{Proposed change} either drop the import from \texttt{Leaner\allowbreak{}VM/\allowbreak{}Protocol/\allowbreak{}Basic.\allowbreak{}lean} (it declares nothing, so it needs none; the policy tests build their own fixture tree, \texttt{scripts/\allowbreak{}test-\allowbreak{}policy-\allowbreak{}checks.\allowbreak{}py:\allowbreak{}35-\allowbreak{}45}, and do not read this file), or add ``the layer's empty root \texttt{Basic.\allowbreak{}lean}'' to the exceptions of \texttt{:\allowbreak{}331} and of acceptance test 25. Then write the rule into \texttt{scripts/\allowbreak{}check-\allowbreak{}layers.\allowbreak{}sh} with an allow-list, and a planted violation in \texttt{scripts/\allowbreak{}test-\allowbreak{}policy-\allowbreak{}checks.\allowbreak{}py}.
\end{finding}
